nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Ignore pattern template for the understand-anything analysis plugin, mirroring .gitignore syntax with all patterns commented out as suggestions for exclusion.

nodes.name: config.json
nodes.summary: Plugin configuration setting the output language preference for understand-anything generated content.

nodes.name: PhilosophyPanel.vue
nodes.summary: Presentational Vue component displaying English learning philosophy — language as a motor skill, scene-based imagination, sentence-level learning, and spaced repetition principles.

nodes.name: useSpeech.js
nodes.summary: Vue composable providing browser-native text-to-speech and speech-to-text capabilities via the Web Speech API, with voice selection, language filtering, and lifecycle cleanup.
nodes.languageNotes: Leverages the browser Web Speech API (SpeechSynthesis and SpeechRecognition) for zero-cost voice capabilities without external services.

nodes.name: useTTS
nodes.summary: Reactive text-to-speech composable wrapping browser SpeechSynthesis with English voice selection, speak/stop controls, and automatic cleanup on component unmount.

nodes.name: useSTT
nodes.summary: Promise-based speech-to-text composable wrapping browser SpeechRecognition with interim results, configurable timeout, and automatic cleanup on component unmount.

nodes.name: style.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet defining CSS custom properties, reset styles, base typography, and layout structures for the ShiYi Vue application.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CSS custom properties for a consistent design token system with variables for colors (primary, success, warning, danger), spacing, border radius, and box shadows.

nodes.name: test_parse_json.mjs
nodes.summary: Test harness validating the parseAIJson function against various AI response formats including markdown code fences, partial JSON, and malformed outputs using the OpenAI SDK.

nodes.name: parseAIJson
nodes.summary: Robust JSON parser handling AI response formats — strips markdown code fences, attempts direct parse, and falls back to substring extraction for partial or malformed JSON.

nodes.name: test_qwen_api.mjs
nodes.summary: Diagnostic script testing the Qwen multimodal API by sending local image files and evaluating the model's image recognition and description capabilities.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Async test runner that finds the smallest PNG image in a directory, sends it to Qwen's vision API for recognition, and logs the model's response with token usage statistics.

nodes.name: vite.config.js
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration enabling the Vue 3 plugin and proxying /api requests to the Express backend at localhost:3001 for development.
